context: A teacher and student discuss a school health lesson
purpose: Teach: 保健/診療/出産/心臓/栄養/毛/透明/願っ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日の保健の授業、ちゃんと聞いてた？
lines.en: Were you actually listening during today's health class?
lines.style: Gentle teacher voice, mildly probing, warm and patient tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 聞いてましたよ。心臓の検査の話と、栄養バランスの話ですよね。
lines.en: I was listening. The talk about heart exams and nutritional balance, right?
lines.style: Bright teenage voice, slightly defensive but cheerful and confident

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうそう。あと、お母さんの出産前後の体の変化についても触れたよね。
lines.en: Exactly. We also touched on bodily changes around a mother's childbirth.
lines.style: Encouraging teacher tone, affirming and thoughtful, evenly paced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あの透明なイラスト、骨まで見えてちょっと怖かったです。髪の毛まで描いてあって。
lines.en: That transparent illustration was a bit scary, even bones and hair showed.
lines.style: Animated teen reaction, slightly squeamish, expressive and giggly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、リアルだったね。来週は近所の診療所の先生がゲストで来てくれるよ。
lines.en: Haha, it was realistic. Next week a local clinic doctor will visit.
lines.style: Warm chuckle, informative teacher voice, building anticipation gently

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本物のお医者さん！質問したいこと、たくさんあります。
lines.en: A real doctor! I have so many things I want to ask.
lines.style: Excited teenage enthusiasm, eager and bright, rising intonation

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: みんなが健康でいてくれることを、先生はいつも願ってるからね。
lines.en: I'm always hoping that all of you stay healthy and well.
lines.style: Sincere caring teacher voice, soft and heartfelt, slower delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。ちゃんとノート、見直しておきますね。
lines.en: Thank you so much. I'll go back and review my notes properly.
lines.style: Grateful polite teen voice, sincere and slightly softer than before
